gates.expect: Version-pinned stable anchor search/page/media/download chain matches E2-v1; browser and synthetic client retain real returned V1 links.

gates.candidate: V2 manifest/metadata paired with V1 SQLite. Every file's declared byte hash matches actual bytes, but DB snapshot/source identity disagrees with target manifest.
gates.expect: Reject with SQLITE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH before publishing a validated release. traffic.json, V1 manifest bytes/hash and last-success.json remain unchanged; last-attempt.json records the failed attempt. Existing V1 complete chain still succeeds. Install success and manual traffic activation are distinct events. No claim of continuous availability.

Valid V2 installs only after closure/identity checks; starting its reader and changing traffic.json are separate recorded operations. Query and content expectations match V2. Old V1 version-pinned requests to new reader return 409 VERSION_MISMATCH with no content. The original browser session can explicitly re-search e2packet, open same page and download V2 PDF; synthetic client independently rebuilds this chain without silently stripping version.

Preserve but make new E2 producer input tree unavailable. Independent DR artifact remains available. Non-author uses only frozen runbook to install into absent/new cache and start a new reader, then completes V2 search/page/PDF chain. Record actual source paths/PID/hashes and all intervention.

versionContract.requestVersionBinding: ?version=<snapshotId> is required on page, media-list and download requests; use the search response snapshotId without transparent token removal

sourceLossBoundary: Single synthetic producer-source role isolation in local filesystem, not actual fz1/fz2/network/cluster failure isolation. Code, independent DR artifact and mock Role service remain available.

handoff.claim: agent runbook operability only; not human on-call acceptance
